title: Add an offline test that the published payment challenge decodes as documented
problem: docs/PAID-CALL.md shows a challenge and a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE envelope, but nothing in the repository checks that the documented shape is the shape the service actually returns. A doc that drifts from the wire format is worse than no doc, because agents code against it.
deliverables: A fixture file holding one captured PAYMENT-REQUIRED base64 string
A test that decodes it and asserts x402Version, accepts[].scheme, accepts[].amount, accepts[].extra.name and accepts[].extra.version
The test wired into the existing runner so npm test covers it
acceptance: The test fails if amount is changed to a string with different digits
The test fails if extra.name is removed
The test makes no network call
npm test passes on a clean clone

required: one line showing the test failing when you deliberately break the fixture
